'''2010 Texas Mini Worlds Day 2 Joe Olson LS You Can Either Profit By This...''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Joe Olson]] at [[2010 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|EJP-L-youcaneitherprofitbythis.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' LS Deck
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
